propositions: The coverage-gap bullet in passing-code-review.md (lines ~112–114) incorrectly instructs contributors to ping a maintainer for re-trigger, but self-service recheck-review is now available.

Ticket bb9b and Gerrit change 1243 landed contributor-triggerable re-review (recheck-review comment), but the packaged guide was not updated, leaving the single most discoverable contributor surface with misdirecting stale text.

The guide must document that a coverage-gap `-1` is an infrastructure veto, not a code finding, and that contributors can self-trigger re-review by commenting `recheck-review` once the infrastructure issue clears.
The update must align the guide with CONTRIBUTING.md §2c and docs/review-policy.md by noting that `recheck` (CI) and `recheck-review` (LLM review) are mirror operations available to contributors.
